title: A quiet fox / Photography
note: Same scene instructions, a different visual language.
prompt:
Create one 3:2 landscape-format artwork.
Subject: a solitary red fox sitting on a moss-covered rock beside a narrow forest stream.
Environment: a quiet ancient pine forest, layered mist between tall trunks.
Composition: the fox occupies the left third, its complete body and bushy tail visible, the stream curves from foreground to the right background, eye-level viewpoint.
Lighting: soft dawn light, pale gold filtering through cool grey mist.
Palette: muted forest green, warm rust orange, slate grey.
Visual language: Fine-art photographic realism. Believable natural detail, realistic textures and atmosphere, restrained editorial finish, subtle depth of field.
Constraints: no people, buildings, text, lettering, watermark, logo, border or collage. This is an imagined scene, not documentary evidence.
